description.en: Soft semolina cake soaked in lemon syrup.
description.ro: Prăjitură fragedă din griș, înmuiată în sirop de lămâie.
description.ar: كيكة سميد طرية مغموسة بشراب الليمون.

ingredients: For the syrup: 1 cup sugar, 1 cup water, 1 tbsp lemon juice
steps: Heat the oven to 180 C and grease a square tin.
Mix the semolina, yoghurt, sugar, butter and baking powder and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Spread in the tin, cut into diamonds and press an almond into each piece.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until golden.
Meanwhile boil the syrup ingredients for 8 minutes and let it cool.
Pour the cool syrup over the hot cake and leave it to soak for 20 minutes.
